name: Kryptos
descriptor: Traditional heavy metal in the spirit of the 80s.
fact: Formed 1998. First Indian heavy metal band at Wacken Open Air (2013). Opened for Iron Maiden in Bangalore, 2009.

name: Gutslit
fact: Active nearly two decades. Toured 25+ countries. New single “I, Berzerker” (2026); fourth album due 2027.

name: Haiku-Like Imagination
descriptor: Math rock and post-hardcore with intricate rhythms, punchy aggression, and playful melodic turns.
fact: Their 2019 debut is called Eat Lead, Motherbuzzer!, and its first single samples comedian Bill Hicks.

name: Fallen Letters
descriptor: Atmospheric progressive rock and metal, balancing melancholy with crushing heaviness.
fact: Their 2025 debut, Mindfractures, drew reviews from as far away as Greece.

name: Backrooms
descriptor: Modern progressive metal driven by technical riffs, heavy grooves, and metalcore energy.
fact: Formed in 2023, they had a full album out by 2025: A Place We’ve All Been Before.

name: Astrit
descriptor: “Heavy Hindustani Music”: progressive metalcore with Hindustani classical melody.
fact: Their single “Kyun Rukun” threads Hindustani classical motifs through modern metal.
